{{Youmay|the [[Terminus-class destroyer]]|the [[Overlord (warship)]] of the same name}}
The '''''Overlord''''' was a [[Terminus-class destroyer|''Terminus''-class destroyer]] operating at the beginning of the [[third Galactic War]]. At one point, it was ambushed by a Republic fighter wing, shortly before the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] attack on the [[Meridian Complex]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref>
